heading: top-left
name: 靠左標題＋圖左文右的分隔線直列
desc: 上方靠左放標題，下方多個項目一列一筆往下排，每列左側一張橫式圖片、右側一段文字，列與列之間有分隔線。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方靠左放標題組，標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字與按鈕，沒有時省略；標題明顯大於項目的標題。標題組下方是多個項目排成的直列，每列一筆，整組對齊頁面內容寬度；標題組下方、列與列之間、最後一列下方都有一條橫跨內容寬度的分隔線。每列無外框，左側放一張橫式圖片，約佔內容寬度的三分之一；右側文字欄約佔三分之二，靠上對齊，由上而下是標題（可多行）與說明文字；標題上方可放小標籤，說明文字下方可放一個附小箭頭圖示的文字連結，沒有時省略，其他元素的位置不變。所有項目的圖片都是橫式、比例相同。
mobile: 每列改為直向堆疊：圖片在上，橫跨內容寬度，下方依序是標題與說明文字，有小標籤或文字連結時分別放在標題上方與說明文字下方。標題組仍在上方靠左。列與列之間、最後一列下方仍保留分隔線。

en.name: Left-aligned heading + image-left text-right rows with dividers
en.desc: A title sits at the top on the left; below it, multiple items run down one per row, each with a landscape image on the left and a block of text on the right, with dividers between rows.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, aligned left. The heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a description and button below; omit them when there is no content. The title is noticeably larger than the item titles. Below the heading group is a list of rows made of multiple items, one item per row, with the whole group aligned to the page content width; a divider spanning the content width runs below the heading group, between rows, and below the last row. Each row has no border: on the left is a single landscape image taking about one third of the content width; on the right is a text column taking about two thirds, aligned to the top, containing from top to bottom a title (may wrap to multiple lines) and a description; optionally place a label above the title and a text link with a small arrow icon below the description; omit them when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements. All item images are landscape with the same proportions.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: Each row is stacked vertically: the image on top, spanning the content width, followed by the title and description; any label or text link goes above the title and below the description respectively. The heading group stays at the top, aligned left. The dividers between rows and below the last row remain.
